lines.en: I bound along on long legs
I keep my body low

lines.zh: 我每跳一下都落得很准
lines.en: Every leap lands exactly
My whips swing at my sides
I leap from stone to stone
My tail drags the ground
I spring closer, hop by hop
I angle around the lava pool
My joints click like iron
I walk and keep my eyes on you
I land without raising dust

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，就到了你面前
lines.en: One spring and I'm in front of you
I crouch and wait for you to move
My whips drag lines in the ground
I tip my head very low
My chest barely moves
I watch your hands
Fire curls near me
I don't blink at all
My knees stay slightly bent
I retract my whips a little
I can go whenever you like
You're crowding me
I lift one whip
You watch my hands; clever

lines.zh: 我歪头，把鞭子绕在腕上。
lines.en: I tilt my head and coil my whip around my wrist.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离刚好够我一下
lines.en: The gap between us is exactly one strike
You retreat; I don't chase, I follow

lines.zh: 你的脚在往后退，我看得见
lines.en: I can see your feet retreating
I tilt my head and a joint clicks
You reek of iron
I won't move first; you do

lines.zh: 我退开一步，鞭子收回来
lines.en: I retreat a pace and pull my whips in
My joints grind loudly
I crouch and recalculate the distance
A gash opens in my hide
I don't cry out; I only exhale

lines.zh: 我跳开，落地时歪了一下
lines.en: I leap away and land crooked

lines.zh: 我抖了抖挨了打的那条臂
lines.en: I shake the arm that took the hit
I stare at you, moving slower
Flame burns at the edge of the wound
I stand up again

lines.zh: 你手上那团热气，别收起来。
lines.en: Do not put away that warm glow in your hand.
I want that little heat
I extend a whip, slowly
Set down what you're holding
Piping hot, and still smelling of iron.
I only want a little
Don't let your hand shake

lines.zh: 我够得着，只是不想吓你
lines.en: I can reach it; I just don't want to scare you
Half a step nearer
Backing up does you no good
My whip drops, and the heat spills.

lines.zh: 我的鞭子缠了一下你的脚
lines.en: My whip catches your ankle
I shoulder you clear

lines.zh: 你的护甲磕在我的膝上
lines.en: Your armor knocks my knee

lines.zh: 我一个翻身就站回来了
lines.en: I roll and come up standing
You push and I flow back
My tail sweeps your legs

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，火星溅开
lines.en: We clash and sparks fly
You take two steps; I don't follow
That didn't even scuff me
One of my kind lands nearby

lines.zh: 我们互相甩了一下鞭子
lines.en: We snap our whips at each other
Its whips are longer than mine

lines.zh: 我的鞭子甩出去，石头都裂。
lines.en: My lash cracks stone.
We crouch together
There's an old scar on its back

lines.zh: 我们同时看向一个方向
lines.en: We look the same way at once
No wasted motion
It moves first; I follow
This hunting ground serves two
I hook it with a whip
I draw it up to look
It's warm; good
I bite it open
What's inside glows
I tuck it at my hip
I throw it away; useless
It broke apart in my grip
You may have this one
I'll keep half of it
You've finally moved
My whips are up
I've wanted this moment a long while

lines.zh: 我跳起来，从上方压下来
lines.en: I leap and come down from above
You've backed to the wall; good
One bend of my legs and I'm on you
You're inside my circle now
This whole area is my arena

lines.zh: 脚一离地，我就到了你侧面。
lines.en: One push off the ground and I am at your flank.
Your guard comes up too late
I let a grin slip out

lines.zh: 鞭子在我手上绕了一圈
lines.en: My whip coils once around my hand
Hot wind comes from behind me
Here I come at you
I bound in circles, hunting an angle
The whip arrives before I do

lines.zh: 你躲开第一下，第二下在等你
lines.en: You dodge the first; the second waits
I slide low across the ground
I never stay in one place
My lash tip curls around behind you first.
I herd you toward the corner

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后保持平衡
lines.en: My tail counterbalances behind me
You guard left; I take right
I land and spring again at once

lines.zh: 烈鞭的鞭梢在空气里等你的呼吸。
lines.en: Whiplash's tip waits in the air for your breath.
I wait for your first swing

lines.zh: 这一块地面被我们踩热了
lines.en: We've heated this ground between us
A missed whip cracks loudly
I tighten the circle step by step
The last one will be very close

lines.zh: 鞭子横着抽在你的胸口
lines.en: My whip cracks across your chest
I leap, knee first

lines.zh: 这一下打在你护甲上，火星四溅
lines.en: The blow lands on your armor in a spray of sparks
The lash turns you half a step

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，双脚踩向你
lines.en: I come down feet first
My tail sweeps your ankle

lines.zh: 这一鞭缠住了你的手腕
lines.en: This whip coils around your wrist
You tear free, leaving skin behind
I slide along the ground behind you

lines.zh: 我的鞭子甩回来，防不住
lines.en: The whip comes back; you can't guard both
You block it, but your hand shakes

lines.zh: 这一下抽空了，我顺势翻过去
lines.en: I miss and roll through
I bring both whips down

lines.zh: 你退了一步，地上有焦痕
lines.en: You fall back a step, leaving scorch marks
I haven't paused at all
Next time you get no time

lines.zh: 我踩在下界岩上，灰还没落。
lines.en: I land on the netherrack before the dust settles.
I land raising only a little dust
My whips touch down first
Firelight finds my shadow
I rise from a crouch
The air tightens all at once

lines.zh: 我抬起一根鞭子，指向你
lines.en: I lift a whip and point it at you
It's a little too bright here

lines.zh: 我先看了看四周的退路
lines.en: I check the exits first
My joints click one by one
I walk in from beside the lava
I'm here; don't wait

lines.zh: 火顺着我的皮爬，我甩不脱
lines.en: Fire climbs my hide and I can't shake it
My legs fail on the landing
Lava floods my mouth and nose
The blast flings me over
An arrow pins my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的关节僵住
lines.en: That force stiffens my joints

lines.zh: 太久没进食，我的动作慢了
lines.en: Too long without food; my moves lag
Lightning strikes and I drop to one knee

lines.zh: 没有地面，我的腿找不到落点
lines.en: No ground; my legs find no landing
